claim: FINRA Regulatory Notice 26-10 replaces the pattern-day-trader designation and the $25,000 minimum with intraday margin standards, effective June 4, 2026, with broker phase-in allowed until October 20, 2027.

evidence.quote: FINRA has adopted new intraday margin standards to replace in their entirety the outdated day trading margin requirements
evidence.source_title: FINRA Regulatory Notice 26-10: FINRA Adopts New Intraday Margin Standards to Replace the Day Trading Margin Requirements

evidence.quote: Effective Date: June 4, 2026; Phase-in Period: Ends October 20, 2027

claim: Interactive Brokers conditional orders can be triggered by the price of another contract (e.g. a stock) and submit or cancel an order, allowing an option exit triggered by the underlying's price.

evidence.quote: A conditional order is an order that will automatically be submitted or cancelled ONLY IF specified criteria for one or more defined contracts are met.

claim: ThetaData individual options plans as of Nov 2026: Value $40/month (1-minute data), Standard $80/month (tick-level NBBO quotes), Pro $160/month.
Massive (formerly Polygon.io) options plans: only the Advanced plan ($199/month) includes quotes; Developer ($79) has trades but not quotes.

CFR working paper 26-02 (Bali, Goyal, Moerke, Weigert) finds half-day option returns show momentum within the same half-day period (intraday or overnight) and reversal across periods, about 0.22-0.45% per half-day, persisting up to 20 business days, for delta-hedged option returns.

evidence.quote: These patterns increase over time, are robust to various delta-hedging schemes and option selection criteria, and persist across different subsamples.
evidence.source_title: In search of seasonality in intraday and overnight option returns
